set -eu
cat > /tmp/cors.json <<'EOF'
{
  "CORSRules": [{
    "AllowedHeaders": ["*"],
    "AllowedMethods": ["GET", "PUT", "HEAD"],
    "AllowedOrigins": ["https://kaneo.${HOME_DOMAIN}"],
    "ExposeHeaders": ["ETag"],
    "MaxAgeSeconds": 3600
  }]
}
EOF
for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do
  if aws --endpoint-url "$S3_INTERNAL_ENDPOINT" --region "$AWS_DEFAULT_REGION" s3api put-bucket-cors --bucket "$S3_BUCKET" --cors-configuration file:///tmp/cors.json; then
    exit 0
  fi
  sleep 5
done
exit 1
